meta.disclaimer: Every trophy on this list is a PROJECTION. Names and requirements are modelled on the Grand Theft Auto V (PS5) trophy list and Rockstar's long-running trophy design patterns. Treat every entry as an educated guess, not a confirmed requirement; check Rockstar's official list or a tracker (Exophase, PSNProfiles) when it becomes available.

gameFacts.setting: State of Leonida, including modern-day Vice City
gameFacts.onlineMode: GTA VI is a single-player experience at launch; Take-Two confirmed existing GTA Online will be supported beyond GTA VI's release, and the shape of any future GTA VI online mode is unannounced.

difficultyScale: 1 = trivial, 10 = extreme grind or skill check

trophies.name: Leonida Legend
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI.
trophies.howTo: Complete the story, reach 100% completion, and mop up all miscellaneous, vehicle and activity trophies. Follow the roadmap: do missable-sensitive trophies as they become available, keep a save backup before late-game story choices, then clean up with free-roam collectible hunting.

trophies.name: The First Score
trophies.description: Complete the opening mission of Jason and Lucia's story.
trophies.howTo: Unmissable. Completing the prologue-style opening mission awards this automatically. Modelled on GTA V's 'Welcome to Los Santos' pattern: every Rockstar story campaign starts with an easy introduction trophy.

trophies.name: Partners in Crime
trophies.description: Complete the early missions where Jason and Lucia begin working together.
trophies.howTo: Expected early-game, unmissable. Rockstar traditionally awards story trophies in chapter-sized batches, so finishing the first act of the campaign should land this.

trophies.name: Halfway to Nowhere
trophies.description: Complete roughly half of the story missions.
trophies.howTo: Progress naturally through the campaign. Watch for optional objectives during this stretch: several likely missable mission trophies (see the Missables section) hide in the mid-game chapters.

trophies.name: Out of Paradise
trophies.description: Complete the final mission of the story.
trophies.howTo: Reach the campaign's conclusion. If GTA VI follows GTA V's pattern of ending choices, back up your save before the final mission so you can experience every ending without replaying the whole game.

trophies.name: Every Job on the Board
trophies.description: Complete every story mission, including optional objectives.
trophies.howTo: Finish all main and side story missions. GTA V's equivalent required gold medals; if GTA VI copies that, expect to replay missions via the pause-menu replay option to earn all mission-specific challenge objectives.

trophies.name: Two Sides of the Same Coin
trophies.description: Play substantial story content as both Jason and Lucia.
trophies.howTo: GTA VI features switching between Jason and Lucia. Play missions from both characters' perspectives as the story rotates control between them; this should come naturally with story completion.

trophies.name: Only in Leonida
trophies.watch: If missions tied to supporting characters (Cal, Boobie, Dre'Quan, Brian, Raul) can be skipped or failed, this may lock for that playthrough. Back up saves before major story beats.
trophies.description: Complete mission chains for all of the major supporting characters.
trophies.howTo: Leonida's cast runs deep. Finish the optional mission chains each supporting character offers rather than rushing the main path. Check your mission list between chapters for anything still open.

trophies.name: Sunshine State: 100%
trophies.description: Attain 100% completion across all stat-tracking activities in the game.
trophies.howTo: Modelled on GTA V's 100% requirements: story missions, hobbies, side encounters, random events, and miscellaneous objectives all count. Track progress on the pause-menu stats screen, which lists exactly what remains. The single longest trophy after the platinum.

trophies.name: Pastime Paradise
trophies.description: Complete every hobby and pastime in Leonida.
trophies.howTo: GTA V's 100% list included specific hobbies. GTA VI's teasers suggest activities like airboat rides, fishing, and drag strips. Do them all as you unlock them; the stats screen will list what counts.

trophies.name: Friendly Faces
trophies.watch: Some optional encounter chains may be tied to specific story chapters; if an encounter stops appearing, check whether you missed it earlier. Back up saves before major story beats.
trophies.description: Complete all optional character encounter chains.
trophies.howTo: Look for the classic question-mark style icons on the map and finish every chain. Between chapters, check the map for encounter icons you haven't touched.

trophies.name: Package Deal
trophies.description: Collect every hidden package scattered across the state of Leonida.
trophies.howTo: Rockstar always hides dozens of collectible pickups across the map. Use a community interactive map after launch, or triangulate once you've found a few. Expect some requiring a helicopter, plane, or dive.

trophies.name: Reef Raider
trophies.description: Collect all underwater collectibles off the coast of Leonida.
trophies.howTo: GTA V had underwater briefcases; GTA VI's Florida coast makes water collectibles near-certain. Get a boat or submersible and sweep the water around Vice City, the Keys-style islands, and offshore wrecks.

trophies.name: Tourist Trap
trophies.description: Visit every point of interest marked on the map.
trophies.howTo: GTA V rewarded discovering all sites of interest in 100%. Drive, fly or boat to every marked landmark, ticking them off region by region from the pause-menu map's list.

trophies.name: Field Photographer
trophies.description: Photograph or document every animal species for the wildlife challenge.
trophies.howTo: GTA VI's trailers showcase dense wildlife: alligators, flamingos, deer and more. Expect a photography or sighting challenge. Carry the phone camera everywhere; some species may be time- or weather-dependent.

trophies.name: Tag Team
trophies.description: Find and spray every graffiti tag location.
trophies.howTo: GTA Online introduced graffiti tags; GTA VI likely brings them to story mode. Look in alleys, under bridges, and behind buildings. Work neighbourhood by neighbourhood to avoid backtracking.

trophies.name: Postcard from Vice City
trophies.description: Take a photo at every named landmark in Vice City and greater Leonida.
trophies.howTo: If a landmark photo challenge exists, work through the list with the phone camera. Pair it with the POI trophy: when you visit a landmark, photograph it too.

trophies.name: The Setup
trophies.description: Complete all preparation missions for a major score.
trophies.howTo: GTA VI's story centres on criminal scores, so expect GTA V-style setup missions before each big job. Complete every prep objective before triggering the heist itself, and pick the best-rated crew if crew choices matter.

trophies.name: Grand Larceny
trophies.watch: If heist approaches (loud vs stealth) are chosen per playthrough, a trophy for all approaches would need replays or a second save. Back up your save before each heist setup.
trophies.description: Complete every major score in the story.
trophies.howTo: Expect 4-8 big scores. Complete each finale. If approach options exist, a separate trophy may require trying multiple approaches — plan for that with save backups.

trophies.name: The Big One
trophies.description: Pull off the story's largest score.
trophies.howTo: The climactic heist is traditionally the hardest mission in the game. Stock up on armour, snacks and ammo beforehand, choose your best crew, and learn the escape route before starting the finale.

trophies.name: Loyalty Program
trophies.watch: Crew choices are permanent per playthrough in GTA V's model. If this requires the same crew all game, back up your save before each crew-selection screen.
trophies.description: Use the same crew members throughout all heists that allow crew selection.
trophies.howTo: If GTA VI lets you pick crew like GTA V did, pick the highest-rated crew every time and stick with them. Note their names at the first heist and never swap.

trophies.name: Clean Getaway
trophies.watch: Missable if stealth approaches are only available on specific heists; use mission replay if you went loud.
trophies.description: Complete a heist without triggering an alarm or losing the stealth bonus.
trophies.howTo: Choose the stealth approach on whichever heist permits it, mark guards and cameras, avoid detection, and never fire unsuppressed weapons. Back up your save before the heist so you can retry cleanly.

trophies.name: Garage King
trophies.description: Own or drive every vehicle in the game.
trophies.howTo: GTA V's hardest vehicle trophy required owning all 250+ vehicles; GTA VI will likely be similar. Buy every car, boat, helicopter and plane from in-game stores, and steal mission-unique vehicles when they appear. Rare spawns are district-specific.

trophies.name: Frequent Flyer
trophies.description: Fly every type of aircraft.
trophies.howTo: Fly a helicopter, a small plane, a jet if available, and any other aircraft. Vice City's airport and local airstrips should stock them. Complete flight school first if it exists.

trophies.name: Captain of the Coast
trophies.description: Pilot every type of boat or watercraft.
trophies.howTo: Leonida's waterways guarantee a deep boat roster: speedboat, fishing boat, airboat (the trailers show them), maybe a submersible. Docks around Vice City and the Keys spawn them.

trophies.name: Stuntman
trophies.description: Complete all stunt jump locations.
trophies.howTo: GTA V had 50 stunt jumps; GTA VI will have its own set marked by classic yellow-ramp geometry. Land cleanly in the target zone and retry any botched jump from the pause menu.

trophies.name: Pimp My Ride
trophies.description: Fully modify a vehicle at a customization shop.
trophies.howTo: Drive any car to a customization shop and buy every upgrade category: engine, turbo, suspension, armour, paint, wheels, cosmetics. A cheap starter car keeps costs low.

trophies.name: Need for Speed
trophies.description: Reach top speed in a high-performance vehicle.
trophies.howTo: Buy or steal the fastest car available, find a long straight highway in Leonida's flat interior, and hold the throttle until the speedometer tops out.

trophies.name: All-Round Athlete
trophies.description: Win a match or round of every sport available.
trophies.howTo: GTA V had tennis, golf, darts and arm wrestling. Win at least one session of each sport GTA VI includes. Most are rhythm-based; learn each one's timing mechanic.

trophies.name: Street Racer
trophies.description: Win every street race event.
trophies.howTo: Street races unlock via map icons once the story progresses far enough. Bring a fast upgraded car and win every tier if races come in tiers.

trophies.name: Gone Fishin'
trophies.description: Catch every fish species or complete the fishing challenge.
trophies.howTo: Fishing appears heavily in GTA VI's coastal setting. Catch each species; rare ones may need specific bait, time of day or location. Log everything in the challenge screen.

trophies.name: Swamp Thing
trophies.description: Complete the hunting challenge in Leonida's wilderness.
trophies.howTo: Hunt in the rural interior north of Vice City. Aim for clean kills with the right weapon per animal, and complete every required hunt on the challenge list.

trophies.name: Top Gun of Leonida
trophies.description: Earn all gold medals in flight school.
trophies.howTo: GTA V's flight school gave a gold trophy for medaling every lesson; expect the same. Practice each lesson, restarting immediately on a low score. Precision landings are the usual difficulty spike.

trophies.name: Sharpshooter
trophies.description: Earn gold on every shooting range challenge.
trophies.howTo: Complete all gun range challenges: accuracy, speed and reload drills. Use the weapon best suited to each drill and replay any that didn't score gold.

trophies.name: Iron Person
trophies.description: Win a triathlon event.
trophies.howTo: GTA V's triathlons were stamina slogs. Build stamina stats through running and swimming first, pace the swim and bike legs, then sprint the run.

trophies.name: Neon Nights
trophies.description: Experience Vice City's nightlife across its venue types.
trophies.howTo: Vice City's clubbing culture is a core theme. Visit each nightlife venue type the game tracks and engage with their minigames — dancing, drinking — to trigger completion.

trophies.name: Wolf of Leonida
trophies.watch: If story missions manipulate stock prices like GTA V's assassination missions, selling too early or doing missions in the wrong order forfeits maximum profit. The trophy itself should only need a profit threshold.
trophies.description: Make a large profit playing the in-game stock market.
trophies.howTo: If GTA VI includes a stock market like GTA V's, buy low, sell high. The classic exploit: invest all cash in a target's competitor before the relevant mission, then sell after the price peaks.

trophies.name: Most Wanted
trophies.description: Survive a maximum wanted level for several minutes.
trophies.howTo: Earn the maximum wanted level in a built-up area, then survive. Steal a fast vehicle, watch for helicopters, and hold out. Ramming police cruisers are the main danger.

trophies.name: Under the Radar
trophies.description: Evade a high wanted level by escaping the search zone.
trophies.howTo: Once wanted, leave the flashing search radius. Respray shops, underground car parks, or simply driving out of the zone all work. Stay hidden until the cops give up.

trophies.name: Stick 'Em Up
trophies.description: Hold up a set number of stores or pedestrians.
trophies.howTo: Aim a weapon at clerks or pedestrians to trigger a holdup and repeat until the count threshold is met. Convenience stores respawn targets after a cooldown.

trophies.name: Boots on the Ground
trophies.description: Escape police on foot after a vehicle pursuit.
trophies.howTo: Get wanted while driving, ditch the car, and hide on foot. Crouch behind buildings, break line of sight, and stay outside the search zone until your wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Peak Condition
trophies.description: Max out all character skills and stats.
trophies.howTo: GTA V required maxing each character's stats: stamina, strength, lung capacity, flying, driving, shooting, stealth. Grind each: run for stamina, shoot at ranges, fly at flight school, drive aggressively for driving.

trophies.name: Real Estate Mogul
trophies.description: Own every purchasable property in the game.
trophies.howTo: Rockstar scatters for-sale properties across the map: safehouses, businesses, garages. Buy them all once the story unlocks the funds; some properties unlock only after specific story chapters.

trophies.name: Arsenal
trophies.description: Own every weapon in the game.
trophies.howTo: Buy all firearms from the gun store as they unlock, and pick up any rare weapons found only during missions or hidden locations. Check your weapon wheel against the store catalog.

trophies.name: Unleashed
trophies.description: Complete all rampage-style challenge events.
trophies.howTo: GTA V's rampage challenges were timed combat trials; GTA VI will likely distribute similar ones. Find each rampage icon on the map, hit the score targets, and replay any that didn't clear.

trophies.name: Grand Theft Auto
trophies.description: Steal a variety of vehicles.
trophies.howTo: The trophy that names the series. Carjack cars, trucks, motorcycles, boats and aircraft until the counter fills. Do it naturally across a playthrough and it pops without effort.

trophies.name: Switch Hitter
trophies.description: Switch between Jason and Lucia a set number of times.
trophies.howTo: Use the character-switch wheel repeatedly until the count pops. Both characters must be unlocked through story progression first.

trophies.name: Dialled In
trophies.description: Use every function of the in-game phone.
trophies.howTo: Open the phone and use each app: contacts, browser, camera, messages, mini-apps. Make a call, take a photo, browse the web. The phone's app list is the checklist.

trophies.name: Director's Cut
trophies.description: Use photo mode or cinematic camera.
trophies.howTo: Open the photo or replay mode from the pause menu and capture or view something to trigger it. Snap a Vice City skyline at dusk while you're at it.

trophies.name: Say Cheese
trophies.description: Take photographs of specific subjects or locations.
trophies.howTo: GTA V asked players to photograph specific landmarks and characters. If GTA VI repeats this, check the photo challenge list and work through it with the phone camera.

trophies.name: Downward Spiral
trophies.description: Complete a yoga or meditation minigame.
trophies.howTo: GTA V required yoga for 100%. Look for a similar wellness activity in Vice City's wellness-culture parody and complete its balance or breathing challenges.

trophies.name: Birdie Watcher
trophies.description: Play and complete a round of golf.
trophies.howTo: GTA V's golf minigame was notoriously fiddly. Learn the swing meter timing, use less power for short clubs, and expect to retry holes. A full round may take 30-45 minutes.

trophies.name: Bullseye
trophies.description: Win a game of darts at a bar.
trophies.howTo: Find a dartboard in any bar. The minigame is rhythm-based: match your pull-back timing to the target's bounce. Best-of-three legs is the usual format — win it.

trophies.name: Bare Knuckle
trophies.description: Win a street brawl or organised fist fight.
trophies.howTo: Block with the defensive button, counter when the enemy swings, then finish with a grapple or heavy punch. A maxed strength stat makes it easier.

trophies.name: Myth Hunter
trophies.description: Discover a hidden easter egg or secret location Rockstar tucked away in Leonida.
trophies.howTo: GTA V rewarded finding UFO and Bigfoot-style easter eggs. Explore clearly deliberate oddities: hidden caves, abandoned buildings, strange radio frequencies, remote islands. Community guides will document them after launch.

roadmap.estimatedHours: 120-180 hours (projected, based on GTA V's platinum taking 80-120 hours plus GTA VI's larger map)

steps.advice: Play the campaign naturally. Do NOT rush: before each major story beat, back up your save (PS5: copy the save to USB or cloud). Keep an eye on optional mission chains and pick them up when they appear. Unlock both protagonists and start using the switch wheel.

Before your first score, decide your approach strategy (stealth vs loud, crew loyalty vs maximum payout) and check the heist trophies above. Save backups before each crew-selection and approach-selection screen.

After the story, systematically hunt collectibles: hidden packages, underwater items, graffiti tags, wildlife photos, points of interest. Do this region by region. Buy every property, vehicle and weapon. Grind stats to maximum.

Work through every sport, race, hunting challenge, fishing challenge, flight school and shooting range. Replay any event that didn't earn gold. This phase overlaps well with Phase 3: do the activity nearest to wherever you're collecting.
Check the pause-menu stats screen for remaining 100% items, then clean up anything left. The platinum unlocks with 100% plus every other trophy above.

missables.intro: Because no official trophy list is modelled here, missability is projected from GTA V patterns. General rule: Rockstar makes almost everything replayable or free-roam accessible, but a handful of trophies have historically been missable in a single playthrough. Save backups are your insurance.
items: Story-mission-specific objectives: some missions only offer one chance at a special objective (a unique vehicle, a stealth bonus, a specific choice). Back up saves before every story mission if you're trophy-focused.
Heist crew loyalty: if a trophy requires the same crew all game, choose your crew at the first heist and never swap.
Heist approaches: if a trophy requires all approach styles, use save backups or the mission replay option.
Supporting-character mission chains: finish optional chains when they're offered rather than assuming they'll still be there after the next chapter.
Stock market manipulation: if missions move stock prices like GTA V's assassinations, invest before the mission and sell after the peak.
Story ending choices: back up before the final mission so you can see every ending without a full replay.
Time-limited or chapter-locked encounters: if an encounter icon vanishes, it may reopen later — GTA V reopened most — but don't count on it.
